item.title: The lost art of XML
item.description:
📝 You can specify that an element must contain an integer, that it must appear exactly once, that certain attributes are required. JSON does not support comments. This is context-dependent parsing that we supposedly left behind.
🔗 Read more: https://marcosmagueta.com/blog/the-lost-art-of-xml/
